definitions.full: H2937. taah [ טָעָה ] verb wander, stray (Late Hebrew id., err ; Aramaic טְעָא , ; Arabic exceed just limit, be immoderate, extravagant , one who deviates from right way: Ethiopic apostasy, superstition, idolatry ) — Qal Participle feminine כְּׅטֹׅעֲיָה Song 1:7 like a wandering (vagrant) woman , for כְּעֹטְיָה ᵑ0 according to ᵑ6 Symm ᵑ9 ᵑ7 Bö Hi Gr and others Hiph`il Perfect אֶתעַֿמִּי הִטְעוּ Ezek 13:10 figurative, they have led astray my people.
